rps.pricePctPerPoint.unit: percent increase in average retail electricity price per percentage point of required renewable share

source.publisher: Greenstone & Nath, 'Do Renewable Portfolio Standards Deliver Cost-Effective Carbon Abatement?' (BFI/EPIC working paper 2019-62; NBER w27325, 2020)
source.table: Event-study estimates: 7 yrs after passage +1.8 pp required share, +11% (+1.3 c/kWh); 12 yrs +4.2 pp, +17% (+2.0 c/kWh)

rps.pricePctPerPoint.notes: Contested. LBNL (Barbose, 2024 status update) puts direct RPS compliance costs at ~4% of retail bills on average in RPS states (3.5% in 2023 ed.; 11-12% in solar carve-out states), which implies a much smaller per-point effect than Greenstone-Nath (whose estimate includes system/integration costs). Recommend TUNABLE with LBNL as the low cross-check. LBNL: https://emp.lbl.gov/news/berkeley-lab-publishes-status-update-state-clean-electricity-standards

source.publisher: U.S. EIA
source.table: FAQ 'How much CO2 is produced per kWh': 0.81 lb/kWh all sources (1,532 MMT / 4,183 billion kWh)
